Corrections

2026-08-04
Every chip, status flag and small note rendered in Times on the published site, where six style rules named a font with no fallback and publishing strips the licensed font file; both font stacks now end in a generic family.
2026-08-04
The About page credited sb53.info to the AI Futures Project; the credit names GovAI, where it was written.Reported by Miles Kodama
2026-08-03
The Connecticut whistleblower quote began at subdivision (1) and dropped the clause governing it, so under this site’s own heading it read as permission to penalize a safety whistleblower, the inverse of the act; the chapeau of Sec. 2(b) is quoted from the same archived text and printed with it.
2026-08-03
The Illinois compute threshold published as 1026 instead of 10^26, 24 orders of magnitude low, on the front page and the Illinois bill page, because the 1 August fetch stripped the exponent markup; a tested re-fetch rebuilt the archive with the exponent intact.
2026-08-03
New York’s effective-date citations quoted the codification note rather than the enacting clause, and carried no text fragment; they quote chapter 96 of 2026, section 3, and link to it.
